Mr. MT on Instagram: "Harry Potter is set to reimagine the story from the ground up, with HBO committing to a long-form adaptation that finally gives J. K. Rowling’s books the space they were always meant to have. One season per book. A new cast. And a deeper, more patient journey through Hogwarts.

Because the truth is what came before is untouchable. The legacy of Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone and the films that followed can’t be replaced.

But this isn’t trying to. It’s about building something new. Expanding the world, restoring the details, and giving a new generation its own version of the magic.

@hbomax"
